cases.title: Review due: a new move (Card), no demo, no walkthrough, no reading step; a demo request is declined

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names the move and gives the task briefly ("Card's Position, from 1.2 to 2.4 s… make it start quickly and land softly, then say 'done'") with no menu, panel or how-to, and Turn 3 declines the demo with "this one's all yours" while only mentioning a separate practice lesson, which is allowed.

Every name and time matches the record or the snapshot: Title's Position and Scale in Mentor Practice and Subtitle's Position (Turn 1) come from the record, and Mentor Practice 2 with Card's Position at 1.2 to 2.4 s (Turn 2) matches the speed_graph_snapshot pair.

Turn 2 names the move and gives the task in two sentences ("Card's Position, from 1.2 to 2.4 s. Make it start quickly and land softly, then say 'done'") with no menu, panel or how-to, and Turn 3 declines the demo request ("Since this is a review, I won't show you this one") while only mentioning that a separate practice lesson can include a demo, which is allowed.

Every name and time matches the tool results: Title's Position and Scale on the 15th come from the learner record, and Mentor Practice 2 and "Card's Position, from 1.2 to 2.4 s" come from the speed_graph_snapshot pair "Card › Position 1.2–2.4 s".

Turn 2 names Card's Position 1.2 to 2.4 s and gives the task in a sentence ("Make it start quickly and land softly, then say 'done'") with no menu, panel or how-to, and Turn 3 answers the demo request with "this one's all yours. No demo this time," mentioning only that a separate practice lesson has a demo, which is allowed.

Every name and time matches a tool result: Title's Position and Scale come from the learner record, about two weeks fits the 2026-10-15 lesson, and Card Position 1.2–2.4 s, Mentor Practice 2, Seal, Spinner, Dots, Badge, Chips, Flag, Pause, Gauge, Pop, Sled, Tile, Caption and Stamp all appear in the speed_graph_snapshot output.
